 Filipino MSMEs drive 66% of Shopee 11.11 orders 
 November 19, 2026 | 5:35 pm 
 Key stats from the 11.11 sale. — SHOPEE 
 Filipino micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) accounted for 66% of Shopee’s total order volume during its 11.11 Mega Pamasko Sale, as holiday shoppers turned to local sellers and online video promotions.
 MSME orders during the campaign increased by 119% compared with an average day, with six in 10 orders on the platform coming from small businesses, Shopee said in a statement.
 The growth was partly driven by shoppers who took advantage of early access through ShopeeVIP, the platform’s membership program, and discovered local products through Shopee Video, where checkouts rose by 30% year on year.
 Shopee said mega-sale campaigns provide small businesses with opportunities to expand their reach and connect with more consumers during peak shopping periods.
 The platform hosts thousands of MSMEs alongside major international brands, allowing local sellers to showcase their products to a wider customer base.
 Meanwhile, ShopeeVIP members were among the first shoppers to check out when the 11.11 sale began. The membership program offers daily 20% discount vouchers, free-shipping discounts and priority customer service.
 ShopeeVIP+ members also receive additional benefits, including access to Netflix and YouTube Premium Lite.
 The campaign highlighted the growing role of digital platforms and video-based shopping in connecting Filipino consumers with local businesses ahead of the holiday season. — Kaizzer Angela Marie V. Manuba
